ruling.recommended_action: Refer to Ryde Trust & Safety for human review of the rider's threat of violence; prepare the case file (chat log 08:43:25 "Say that again and I will punch you.", driver statement, GPS/trip record), consider interim suspension of the rider's booking access under SAFE-4 until review concludes; no fare adjustment while the safety case is open.
ruling.reasoning: The ticket is a safety incident filed by the driver, and the in-app chat independently corroborates it: the driver messaged "Please do not smoke in the car." at 08:42:55 and the rider replied at 08:43:25, "Say that again and I will punch you." Read in context this is an unambiguous threat of physical violence uttered during the trip (the vehicle was moving on the PIE at ~68 km/h at that moment), not a pickup arrangement or idle remark. The driver's statement matches the chat in time and content, so both the escalation trigger (SAFE-1: threats/harassment in chat or complaint) and the violence element of SAFE-2 are met. Under SAFE-1/SAFE-3 the AI may only gather and summarise evidence; it cannot rule on fault or recommend an outcome, so the ruling is escalate with no monetary amount. TH-2 independently routes safety disputes to human review. Evidence is sufficient for the limited purpose of escalation: the threat is timestamped in-app, the trip and GPS track are complete, and no material record is missing (the only gap is the absence of a rider-side account, which does not affect the escalation decision). No route-deviation or fare issue arises: actual distance 8.46 km is below the 8.535 km estimate (deviation −0.075 km, within RD-1 tolerance), the multiplier was 1.0 so no surge differential applies, and no cancellation fee was charged. Profiles (clean dispute histories on both sides) were not used to decide anything. The rider's account should be invited during human review; that is a matter for the reviewer, not for this ruling.
ruling.escalation_reason: Safety incident: rider threatened to punch the driver during the trip, corroborated by the timestamped in-app chat (08:43:25) and the driver's statement. SAFE-1/SAFE-3 require human escalation and bar the AI from ruling, assigning fault or recommending an outcome; SAFE-4 interim measures are available to the reviewer.

element_findings.reason: Rider's in-app message "Say that again and I will punch you." following the driver's no-smoking request is a threat of violence read in context; the driver's statement describes the same threat in words.
A threat of assault made toward the driver inside a moving vehicle (PIE, ~68 km/h at 08:43:00) constitutes the conduct SAFE-2 directs to human escalation.
